title: Posterior depends on the prior
input: Evidence has Bayes factor 20 in favor of H. Compare prior P(H)=0.01 with prior P(H)=0.5. Choose the correct report.

option_menu.A: The posterior is always about 95.2%, regardless of the prior.
option_menu.B: The posterior is always about 16.8%, regardless of the prior.
option_menu.C: The posterior is about 16.8% from prior 0.01 and about 95.2% from prior 0.5; both are prior-conditional.
option_menu.D: A Bayes factor of 20 proves H is true.
